label: AI success platform loop
query: Explain the AbarVa success loop from CXO upload to Move gate to Source artifact to Tower value for Lakeshore.
answer: My read For Lakeshore Holdings, the AbarVa “success loop” is: you (as CXO) upload a live question, Sentinel shapes it into a concrete Move, Source turns that Move into contract- and system-grade artifacts, and Tower proves – in dollars and KPIs – whether programs like Freight visibility and exception AI or Kyriba are actually delivering the promised value. Why it matters for Lakeshore You already have a substantial AI/modernization slate (e.g., Kyriba global treasury rollout at $18M / $42M projected, Freight visibility and exception AI at $6.4M / $18M, and multiple Holdco AI workflow pilots). The loop is about tightening the chain from “idea” to “evidence-backed value” across that portfolio. Your AI-tool footprint (Salesforce Einstein, Databricks Assistant, Copilot for M365, ServiceNow Now Assist, custom freight exception model) plus the Shared data platform and evidence spine program means you have the substrate to actually instrument this. How the loop works, step by step 1) CXO upload (question → intent) You drop a question like “Should we double down on AI workflow pilots vs. fix value-lag programs?” or “What is the AI success platform loop for Lakeshore?”. Sentinel grounds this in your real context – your initiative portfolio, Azure AI Search-based vector substrate, and org roles (e.g., Meera Rao as Global/Holdco CIO, Daniel Whitaker as Holdco CFO). rawEvents.text: My read For Lakeshore Holdings, the AbarVa “success loop” is: you (as CXO)
upload a live question, Sentinel shapes it into a concrete Move, Source turns
that Move into contract- and system-grade artifacts, and Tower proves – in
dollars and KPIs – whether programs like Freight visibility and exception AI or
Kyriba are actually delivering the promised value. Why it matters for Lakeshore
You already have a substantial AI/modernization slate (e.g., Kyriba global
treasury rollout at $18M / $42M projected, Freight visibility and exception AI
at $6.4M / $18M, and multiple Holdco AI workflow pilots). The loop is about
tightening the chain from “idea” to “evidence-backed value” across that
portfolio. Your AI-tool footprint (Salesforce Einstein, Databricks Assistant,
Copilot for M365, ServiceNow Now Assist, custom freight exception model) plus
the Shared data platform and evidence spine program means you have the substrate
to actually instrument this. How the loop works, step by step 1) CXO upload

workflow pilots vs. fix value-lag programs?” or “What is the AI success platform
loop for Lakeshore?”. Sentinel grounds this in your real context – your
initiative portfolio, Azure AI Search-based vector substrate, and org roles
(e.g., Meera Rao as Global/Holdco CIO, Daniel Whitaker as Holdco CFO). Output: a
